caption:
Why do most of these come as a shot and not a pill? 🔬 Your digestive system exists to take protein chains apart, so a swallowed chain mostly becomes lunch. One oral version reaches the blood at roughly one percent, and only with a helper molecule added.

Which chains survive the gut is listed for each one: pepsafe.info
